questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "limit-up" mean?
options: The stock was removed from trading permanently
The company announced a new product line
The stock price fell to its lowest level of the year
The stock price reached the highest allowed increase for the day
questions.explain_en: "Limit-up" means the stock hit the maximum price increase allowed for that trading session.
questions.explain_zh: 「limit-up」指的是該股票在當天達到允許的最高漲幅。

questions.question: In the summary, what does the phrase "heterogeneous integration" mean?
